crossRefs.note: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say…
No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

translations.web: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.
translations.bsb: But they remained silent. Then Jesus took hold of the man, healed him, and sent him on his way.
translations.kjv: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;
